NSE:GRANULES.businessSummary: Hyderabad-based pharma manufacturer of finished dosage forms, formulation intermediates and APIs, focused on high-volume off-patent products (paracetamol, metformin, ibuprofen) sold to 300+ customers in 80+ countries across regulated US/EU markets.

notes.announcementTitle: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
notes.insight: Granules secured Sole First-to-File (FTF) ANDA status for Sodium Oxybate Extended-Release for Oral Suspension, the generic of LUMRYZ (a narcolepsy/cataplexy drug). This is the companys second Sole FTF ANDA after Amphetamine ER Tablets (generic Dyanavel XR), signalling growing capability in complex, differentiated generics rather than commodity products. Sole FTF status typically confers 180-day marketing exclusivity in the US on approval, which can be materially margin-accretive versus Granules base paracetamol/metformin business, but the PDF gives no revenue estimate, approval timeline, or launch date — actual P&L impact is unquantifiable from this filing alone. No prior notes exist for this company to compare against. Watch for: FDA approval/launch timing and management commentary on expected US market size for this molecule in the next concall.
